Dear evening team,
After lunch changed little, but gate queues stayed in focus

Thank you for keeping the Companion Animal Travel Desk steady through a busy stretch. The handoff notes are helping us keep pet travel smooth, and I appreciate the calm way everyone has been checking carrier fit, documents, and the comfort of each animal before the handover to the next team. That care matters when travelers arrive stressed, and it helps us keep the service warm and consistent across Aurelia Skyways.

Please keep reminding travelers to stay close to the desk for final checks, and please route any doubtful cases to the senior coordinator without delay. <<FACT F012>> If a case includes a nervous pet, use a softer approach, speak slowly, and make sure water and relief guidance are offered with clear, simple wording. We should continue to share practical instructions with crews so they can support the same standard at the gate and on the ramp.

I also want everyone to keep watch for late changes in pet paperwork and carrier condition, since those are the points that tend to slow the line. <<FACT F016>> When you pass along updates, keep the wording brief and direct so the next teammate can act without confusion. If Jonah Garcia or Liam Ibrahim comes through again with Skye, please make sure the welcome is steady and the process stays gentle. Safety still comes first, and a patient tone helps the whole journey go better for both travelers and pets.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
